ambiguities.issue: The exclusion list bans 'football' and 'hurling' but does not name Gaelic football. Read literally, Gaelic football is not excluded. It is treated as INCLUDED (6 live club & championship rows on 2026-10-22) and tagged ambiguous_exclusion=true so it can be filtered cleanly.
Cycling is excluded; Formula 1 motor racing is distinct and not named in the exclusion list.
Horse racing is excluded; greyhound racing is distinct and not named in the exclusion list.
